title: After the Kikuka Sho: Becoming a Single Radiant Bloom

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Carve it into the turf! Kindle the fire—
This day shall be mine...!!)

text_block_list.name: Pisa & Ruler & Flash
text_block_list.text:
'Give it your all, Rose-san!'
'Make your move, Rose!'
'Du schaffst es! Rose-san!'

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaaaaah—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Woooaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: What incredible fervor—!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah... ahh—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...The tailwind... has begun to blow—

text_block_list.name: Young Rose
text_block_list.text: Friends... you say?

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The way you devotedly apply yourself
to training each day earns the deepest respect
from all of us Trainers.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, if I may speak frankly at the risk of impudence,
I wonder if you might be restraining yourself
from spending time with your friends.

text_block_list.name: Young Rose
text_block_list.text:
...
I have things that I must accomplish.

text_block_list.name: Young Rose
text_block_list.text:
Above all else,
fulfilling our long-cherished wish—at present, I require nothing more.

text_block_list.name: Young Rose
text_block_list.text: If friends are what I require, please allow me to save that for when my cherished ambition is realized—when a new path begins.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Rose-san!
That was a magnificent race!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (... To think that such a warm breeze could ever exist—)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fervent cheers erupted, washing over Rose Kingdom
like a warm embrace.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
'Gave me goosebumps!' 'Reminded me of the Derby.'
'A lot of the regulars weren't there, but it was a great race to cap off the generation.'

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: "'—Rose is truly the representative of our generation.'"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...—If on this very day,
I have reigned supreme at the summit,
there could be no greater honor.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: The days spent challenging the Classic Triple Crown made my life shine brighter than anything else—!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Let us ascend to even greater heights.
Please, keep your eyes on the path I trace!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And thus, the Classic Triple Crown campaign came to a close, accompanied by soaring excitement for Rose Kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Once again, my thanks. I was able to give my all today.
The public's reception exceeded my expectations as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To you, and to all our peers...
I cannot thank you enough.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It was not merely an improvement in ability.
I have received so many dazzling things.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: However—it is far from enough.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The racing world is a realm where only the fierce gather.
Once you advance to the Senior class,
you will be buffeted by a whole new tide.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The Rose Clan must be synonymous with steadfast victory.
I must solidify that absolute equation.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Only by achieving that
can we truly say our prestige has been established.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Establishing our prestige—when it comes to the stage on which
we must challenge for that purpose, one comes to mind.
choice_data_list: How about the Japan Cup for your next race?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—I see.
A GⅠ where formidable contenders gather from home and abroad.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Above all else—
"Buena Vista" will likely be running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Buena Vista—a sensitive, gentle-hearted Umamusume on the Tiara path who currently boasts four GⅠ victories.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I promise I will show everyone a truly magnificent view!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beyond her record on the track,
what makes her truly terrifying is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Woooooah!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It lay in her overwhelming popularity.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The conviction that 'she can do it'――
a prowess and charisma great enough to ceaselessly inspire such belief.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: She is truly the queen of this era.
choice_data_list: Therefore, let us take on the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...
Just what kind of breathtaking view awaits from the summit?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I shall have you vacate the throne.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: "The Tenno Sho (Autumn)—over yielding turf, Buena Vista unleashed an explosive burst down the stretch! In a class of her own, she cruises across the finish line with ease!"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: "Having brushed off the fierce pursuit of seventeen rivals seeking to dethrone the queen, the reigning champion and beloved Umamusume—Buena Vista's battle is far from over."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...She truly is magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: You're here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Casting my gaze alongside Rose Kingdom,
standing there was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The undisputed queen of that era: Buena Vista.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Another beautiful day...
All right, I've got to give today's training my all!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Um, Buena-san...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: If you wouldn't mind, might I ask you to run alongside me?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I have heard your passion for the Japan Cup
is nothing short of extraordinary.
Allow me to add my earnest request as well.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—Vying for Her Majesty's favor, are we?
In that case, allow me to join the fray.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Though I plan to bypass the Japan Cup, the one reigning supreme
at the pinnacle of the Twinkle Series stronghold right now
is you.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of my brilliant future,
I'd like to request an audience right here and now.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Everyone...! I know all about your amazing feats. I've always looked up to you!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Even so.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup is one race I cannot surrender.
Because it is the special race where Special Week
brought such profound inspiration to all of Japan.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Out on that track, I want to run proudly
as the Buena Vista that everyone loves.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I would be honored to run alongside you.
I want to defeat everyone, too.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
What a fortuitous coincidence.
Yet—I am truly grateful.
choice_data_list: Let us take a good, careful look.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Up front were Victoire Pisa and Eishin Flash.
With Rulership and Buena Vista holding back in the rear, the race steadily unfolded.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And now, into the final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bursting through with magnificent force from the far outside,
it was none other than Buena Vista!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaah—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa gives chase with a furious late burst,
but the gap slowly widens nonetheless—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The joint practice concluded with Buena Vista taking an overwhelming victory.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah...!
I couldn't... reach it—!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... what's with that overwhelming power play?
There's no point in coming up with plans like that, man...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The growth required before the Japan Cup...
Yet, will it be in time—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Fufu, yes...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
At the Japan Cup, too, Buena Vista
will surely rise to the very top!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: How utterly ferocious—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Could we perhaps arrange
a joint training session with my peers?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It seems Ruler will be resting for a while longer, but
Pisa and Flash-senpai clearly have their sights
set on the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: The towering wall standing before everyone, just as we witnessed, is undeniably Buena.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Polishing their skills broadly through joint training
should be a welcome prospect for them as well.
And above all, for me—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Rose-san!
That was a magnificent race!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
They are exceptional.
――They will undoubtedly achieve great growth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That the presence of her peers served as fuel for Rose Kingdom's growth was something I had sensed for a long time.
choice_data_list: By all means, allow me to arrange it.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your cooperation.
Together, let us strive for even greater results.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for the wonderful suggestion.
Let us become stronger together.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
While I'm at it,
I might as well pick up some intel to use for our next move.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
There are 33 minutes until the mock race begins.
Let us commence with the stretching routine immediately.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: All Four
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaah—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With our sights set on surpassing the Queen, Buena Vista—
the days of running forward together had begun.
